digest.component_or_area: AST provenance test helpers and indexing
propositions: The session-scoped provenance fixture rebuilds parent maps and rescans the entire source tree for every caller lookup, causing 9.54M ast.walk iterations and 49.96–53.58s setup overhead across Ubuntu CI cells.
Parent/enclosing-function and call-site relationships are recomputed from cached AST rather than indexed once, violating the pattern used by pytest, Django, and Astroid.
An immutable process-local index built once from cached parsed trees reduces cold-scan time from 3.26s to 0.81s (~4x) while preserving all 24 ordered provenance tuples and verdict guards.
A deterministic oracle enforcing ≤3 whole-module walks detects reintroduction of repeated whole-tree rediscovery and validates the fix without source-text coupling.
